testcase.name: Rule: Dockable Properties commands reuse the Properties shell: Scenario: Reuse a two-profile sketch after applying an extrusion: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/feature-properties/feature-properties.feature:131:5
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Reuse a two-profile sketch after applying an extrusion ✔ Given a fresh copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-dimension-pick.opd` is open ✔ And the user opens Extrude with the rectangular profile selected and a valid preview ✔ And Keep sketches visible on (+) is checked in Advanced Settings ✔ When the user clicks Apply and create new ✔ Then the first extrusion is committed ✔ And the same sketch remains visible with the separate circular profile available for selection ✔ When the user selects the circular profile for the next draft ✔ Then the second draft uses that profile without changing the first extrusion
